shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'; cat package.json; printf '\\n--- app ---\\n'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '\\n--- main ---\\n'; cat src/main.tsx; printf '\\n--- nested agents ---\\n'; find . -name AGENTS.md -print"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n \"withTableSorting|withTableSelection|TableColumnConfig|Pagination\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -40; rg -n \"withTableSorting|withTableSelection\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.d.ts; rg -n \"export declare function Pagination|declare const Pagination|interface PaginationProps|type PaginationProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components -g '*.d.ts'; rg -n \"export.*Table\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/Table.d.ts; printf '\\n--- pagination types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- table types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg -n \"interface TableColumnConfig|interface TableProps|type TableDataItem\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table -g '*.d.ts'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSorting/withTableSorting.js 2>/dev/null | head -120; printf '\\n--- selection ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.js 2>/dev/null | head -120; printf '\\n--- css ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc/withTableSelection/withTableSelection.css 2>/dev/null"
